text:
Jess (support): Customer acct-acme-9812 says the Embeddings usage chart is labeled 'tokens' but the raw numbers line up with vector counts. They reported a billing spike around 2026-03-12 11:20-11:40 UTC and attached a screenshot.

Sam (eng): Can you share the grafana panel id and some example request_ids from that window?

Jess (support): Panel id grafana:rwd-embed-overview-v3. Customer sample req ids: req_44a7, req_44af, req_44b3. Time window as above.

Maya (analytics): Noted. metrics-collector v2 (deployed ~48h ago) added a units normalizer for legacy clients that maps 'vectors' -> 'tokens'. I'm going to grep ingest logs for those req ids.

MetricsBot: ingest-log [2026-03-12T11:25:02Z] emit_embed_metric request_id=req_44a7 units=vectors count=512 customer=acct-acme-9812
MetricsBot: ingest-log [2026-03-12T11:25:02Z] emit_embed_metric request_id=req_44a7 units=tokens count=512 customer=acct-acme-9812

Sam (eng): Those two lines are telling — duplicate emits for the same request_id but with different units. Suspect cache-replay path emitted the original event and the normalizer re-emitted a mapped event; aggregator didn't dedupe because the unit tag changed.

Sarah (prod): Timeline: metrics-collector v2 added post-hoc cache-warmup replay. I asked for a dedupe key, but the shipped dedupe omitted normalization-version. So identical request_ids with differing units bypassed dedupe.

Tony (support): Customer is on Dedicated and billing flagged this as an escalation. They need an ETA to resolve before EOD.

Maya (analytics): Quick repro script for staging to reproduce double emit:

```
# simulate cache replay + normalizer
emit_event --req req_foo --units vectors --count 768
replay_cache --req req_foo
# normalizer remaps vectors->tokens and re-emits
```

Sam (eng): Short-term mitigation: change aggregator to dedupe on (request_id, customer_id) ignoring units. That's a small change we can hotfix. Long-term fix: add replay_id and normalization-version to event schema and make normalizer idempotent.

Jess (support): Can you provide a short ETA I can share with the customer?

Sam (eng): ETA: hotfix (agg dedupe by request_id) -> ~2h to stage + 30m canary + 10m full roll. Starting now.

DeployBot: Starting rollout: metrics-aggregator@hotfix-dedupe-2026-03-12 to staging (sha:b12f9)

Maya (analytics): To verify, change grafana query to group by request_id:
```
SELECT request_id, sum(count) FROM embed_metrics WHERE ts BETWEEN X AND Y GROUP BY request_id;
```
That will show whether duplicated rows collapse.

DeployBot: Canary to prod (5%) started for metrics-aggregator@hotfix-dedupe-2026-03-12
DeployBot: Canary passed. Rolling to 100%.

Sam (eng): Deployed to prod. Aggregator now collapses duplicates. Example agg-log entry: [2026-03-12T14:02:18Z] aggregated request_id=req_44a7 units=tokens count=512 (previous duplicates collapsed).

Jess (support): Notified ACME: "We've identified a metrics aggregation bug causing double-counting when cache-replay and unit-normalizer both emit. Hotfix deployed to prod; counts should stabilize within ~60 minutes. We're working on a permanent idempotency fix." :thumbsup:

Billing Team: Pausing manual charge escalations; will recompute after 1 hour and confirm.

Maya (analytics): Follow-ups: add replay_id to event schema, attach normalization-version to emitted events, and add an integration test that runs cache-warmup + normalizer to assert no duplicate emits. Filing ticket.

Sam (eng): Created GH issue rwd/metrics#462: "prevent double-counting from cache-replay + units-normalizer" with patch and postmortem notes.

Jess (support): Customer confirmed numbers trending down after ~40 minutes. Closing the loop.

Sarah (prod): Also recommend an alert on embeddings dashboards for sudden vector:token ratio > 1.5 to catch regressions early.

Jess (support): Noted. Closing thread.
